title.en: US replaces temporary tariffs with new Section 301 duties
title.zh: 美国以新的 Section 301 关税取代临时关税

summary.en: New Section 301 additional duties apply by origin from 2026-07-24, replacing the temporary Section 122 10% surcharge that expired the same day. The 2025 IEEPA tariffs had already ended on 2026-02-24 after the Supreme Court ruling of 2026-02-20. Several partners have combined caps on MFN plus 301 duties; exemptions and Section 232 goods are handled separately.
summary.zh: 自 2026-07-24 起，美国按原产国征收新的 Section 301 附加关税，取代同日到期的临时 Section 122 10% 附加税。2025 年的 IEEPA 关税已在最高法院 2026-02-20 裁决后于 2026-02-24 终止。部分伙伴适用 MFN 加 301 的合计上限；豁免和 Section 232 商品另行处理。

title.en: EU applies €3 flat duty to low-value parcels
title.zh: 欧盟对低价值包裹征收 €3 固定关税

summary.en: From 2026-07-01 a temporary flat customs duty of €3 applies to low-value B2C parcels up to €150, until the EU customs data hub regime is in place (around 2028).
summary.zh: 自 2026-07-01 起，对 €150 以下的 B2C 低价值包裹征收 €3 临时固定关税，直到欧盟海关数据中心制度生效（约 2028 年）。

title.zh: 平台图片预设完成复核

summary.en: Reviewed the built-in image size and file-size references for Amazon, Walmart, eBay, Temu, AliExpress, Shopee, TikTok Shop, Lazada and Shopify. Temu and TikTok Shop file-size caps are reference values; Lazada uses a conservative 2 MB.
summary.zh: 复核了亚马逊、沃尔玛、eBay、Temu、速卖通、Shopee、TikTok Shop、Lazada 和 Shopify 的内置图片尺寸与体积参考。Temu 和 TikTok Shop 的体积上限为参考值；Lazada 采用保守的 2 MB。
